meta.title: Archive Sector Report
meta.author: Sample Writer
meta.premise: A quiet archive opens one sealed record, and the player must choose between dangerous truth and fragile safety before the system erases both.

nodes.title: Intro
nodes.speaker: Archivist
nodes.text:
The warning lights in the archive return after months of silence.

A sealed drawer unlocks on its own, and the queue purge clock begins counting down.
nodes.writer_note: Open with curiosity and a visible clock. The player should feel that waiting already costs something.

nodes.title: Incident
nodes.text:
Inside the drawer are two records that cannot both be true.

One names a witness who was erased from the official archive. The other shows the power room failing fast enough to wipe the queue before dawn.
nodes.writer_note: Split the route into truth versus protection so the player feels two different instincts immediately.

choices.text: Follow the erased witness before the trail closes.
Stabilize the power room before the archive burns its own evidence.

nodes.title: Clue
nodes.text:
Inside the witness file, one line is written by hand: 'The clean copy was made after the body count.'

The truth is no longer abstract. Someone edited the archive to make the loss look smaller.
nodes.writer_note: One sharp clue is enough, but it should deepen the emotional cost of choosing truth.

nodes.title: Pressure
nodes.text:
The power room is still running, but one more surge will erase the active record queue.

You can save the archive or chase the truth, but you do not have time to do both.
nodes.writer_note: Make hesitation expensive and concrete. The player should feel the cost of protecting others.

nodes.title: Decision
nodes.text: You can expose the altered record now and let the fallout spread, or lock the archive down and keep the surviving records safe at the price of silence.
nodes.writer_note: The endings should differ in sacrifice, not just in wording.

choices.text: Release the altered record and accept the public damage.
choices.writer_note: Clarity first, even if it hurts everyone watching.

choices.text: Seal the archive and protect what still remains.

nodes.title: Ending A
nodes.speaker: Archivist
nodes.text:
The altered record reaches the council by dawn.

Nothing stays quiet after that, but the erased witness is finally named and the archive can no longer pretend the loss was small.
nodes.writer_note: Show both the rupture and the relief.

nodes.title: Ending B
nodes.speaker: Archivist
nodes.text:
The archive survives the surge, and the surviving records stay intact.

The crossed-out line remains unread, but the people still inside the system wake up to one more safe morning.
nodes.writer_note: Keep the unresolved feeling intentional, not empty.
